data.name: Issues.MediaControlsUnavailable.Title
data.value: Windows media controls are not available

data.name: Issues.MediaControlsUnavailable.Description
data.value: The plugin could not connect to the Windows media session service, so it cannot see what any app is playing. It needs Windows 10 version 2004 or newer. If Windows has only just started, retry in a moment.

data.name: Issues.MediaControlsUnavailable.StillUnavailable
data.value: The Windows media session service is still not reachable.

data.name: Issues.Unknown
data.value: This issue is not known to the plugin.

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnMissing.Title
data.value: VLC needs a small add-on to show up here

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnMissing.Description
data.value: VLC does not report what it plays to Windows on its own. The free vlc-win10smtc add-on makes it: download the {architecture} zip (it has to match your VLC, not Windows), copy libwin10smtc_plugin.dll from it into {folder} and come back here. This plugin switches the add-on on for you in the next step.

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnMissing.Opened
data.value: The download page opened in your browser.

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnMissing.OpenFailed
data.value: The download page could not be opened. It is at {url}.

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnDisabled.Title
data.value: Turn on VLC's media controls add-on

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnDisabled.Description
data.value: The vlc-win10smtc add-on is installed but switched off in VLC. Turn it on here, then restart VLC.

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnDisabled.Enabled
data.value: Turned on. Restart VLC to start using it.

data.name: Issues.VlcAddOnDisabled.EnableFailed
data.value: VLC's settings could not be changed. Close VLC and try again.

data.name: Events.TrackChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when an app starts playing a different track, video or stream.

data.name: Events.PlaybackStateChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when an app starts playing, pauses or stops.

data.name: Events.CurrentAppChanged.Description
data.value: Fires when Windows switches the media controls to a different app, for example from Spotify to a browser.

data.name: Events.Parameters.App.Description
data.value: Optional. Only fires for this app.

data.name: Events.Parameters.State.Description

data.name: Issues.MediaControlMissing.Title
data.value: Install media-control to use System Media on macOS

data.name: Issues.MediaControlMissing.Description
data.value: macOS only lets Apple's own programs read what is playing. The free media-control tool does that for this plugin. Install it with Homebrew by running {command} in Terminal, then press Check again.

data.name: Issues.MediaControlMissing.StillMissing
data.value: media-control is still not installed. Run {command} in Terminal and try again.

data.name: Issues.MacMediaUnavailable.Title
data.value: macOS Now Playing is not available

data.name: Issues.MacMediaUnavailable.Description
data.value: The plugin reads Now Playing through media-control, and that is not working. A macOS or media-control update can cause this. Update it with brew upgrade media-control and retry. If it keeps failing, report it together with the plugin log.

data.name: Issues.MacMediaUnavailable.StillUnavailable
data.value: macOS Now Playing is still not reachable.

data.name: Issues.PlatformUnsupported.Title
data.value: This operating system is not supported yet

data.name: Issues.PlatformUnsupported.Description
data.value: System Media supports Windows, macOS and Linux.

data.name: Issues.ExactYouTubeInfo.Title
data.value: Exact YouTube info is available in the settings

data.name: Issues.ExactYouTubeInfo.Description
data.value: YouTube in Firefox, Chrome and Edge often reports another video's title, channel and cover, typically after you hovered over other videos. System Media's settings have a switch for exact YouTube info: while it is on, the plugin reads the browser's open tabs (which makes the browser switch on its accessibility support) to find the video that is really playing, and looks up its title, channel and cover on YouTube. It stays off until you switch it on, and this notice goes away once it is on.

data.name: Actions.ShowNextPlayingApp.Description
data.value: When several apps play at the same time, switches the System Media - Any app player to the next one that plays. It stays there while that app plays.

data.name: Actions.ShowNextPlayingApp.NothingElsePlaying
data.value: No other app is playing right now.

data.name: Actions.SetDefaultAudioDevice.Description
data.value: Makes a speaker, headset or microphone the system's default.

data.name: Actions.SetDefaultAudioDevice.Role.Description
data.value: Only Windows has separate defaults for calls; elsewhere they are the plain defaults.

data.name: Actions.SetDefaultAudioDevice.NotSupported
data.value: Audio devices cannot be changed on this system.

data.name: Actions.SetDefaultAudioDevice.Failed
data.value: The default device could not be changed.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Settings.Description
data.value: Optional settings. System Media works without changing any of them.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Settings.UnknownStep
data.value: This settings page is out of date. Close it and open the settings again.

data.name: ConfigFlow.Settings.ExactYouTubeInfo.Description
data.value: Reads Firefox's, Chrome's and Edge's tabs to find the YouTube video that is really playing and looks up its title, channel and cover on YouTube, because YouTube's hover previews leave another video's info in the browser. Reading the tabs makes the browser switch on its accessibility support.

data.name: MusicPlayer.Options.Cycle.Description
data.value: While several apps play at the same time, this widget shows each of them in turn. Its buttons control the app it shows.

data.name: MusicPlayer.Options.CycleSeconds.Description
data.value: How long each playing app is shown before the next one.

data.name: Issues.LinuxMediaUnavailable.Description
data.value: Linux media players publish what they play over D-Bus (MPRIS), but this plugin could not connect to the D-Bus session bus. This happens when Macro Deck runs outside a desktop session, for example as a system service. Start Macro Deck from your desktop session and try again.

data.name: Issues.LinuxMediaUnavailable.StillUnavailable
data.value: The D-Bus session bus is still not reachable.
